future_required: Root review and explicit synthetic-test authorization first; retain test failures. Then separately reviewed source/control binding in a fresh namespace and a new exact13-key GO after actual build/freeze/outer/launcher review. Never replay/reset/regrade the failed attempt.

original_failure.lookup_location: Receipt lacks traceback; enumeration-lstat and later size-stat both have this race.

proposed_observation_policy.conservative_failed_attempts: Keep the maximum already-observed partial total if a later complete observation is smaller.
proposed_observation_policy.deadline: Same absolute original deadline checked during walks, before retries and before success.
proposed_observation_policy.directory_scopes: Recursive numerical roots, optional before creation; shallow OUT root as before.
proposed_observation_policy.other_errors: Fail; never skip arbitrary errors or turn them into0 bytes.
proposed_observation_policy.strict_artifact_enumeration: Unchanged; no live-volume retry policy applied to source/artifact hash coverage.
proposed_observation_policy.temporary_entries: Count every observed regular filename, including temporary names, via its single lstat size.
proposed_observation_policy.terminal_monitor_failure: Explicit negative stop_reason/output_observation_error and unknown output_bytes after child cleanup.
